***Create Your Personal my Social Security Account*** *You are required to sign in to your existing personal my Social Security account, or create one. All new my Social Security customers will now create a credential with our credential service providers Login.gov or ID.me. To create a personal my Social Security account, you must be a U.S. citizen, at least* ***18 years old, and have a valid email address and Social Security number. Go to ssa.gov/myaccount*** and select the “Create an Account” button.
The information below will help you gather the information you may need to create your personal *my Social Security account and complete the online Medicare, Retirement, and Spouse’s applications. We* recommend you print this page to use while gathering your information.
